sql: SELECT t.market_ticker, string_agg(t.strategy || ':' || t.status || ':' || coalesce(round(t.pnl::numeric,2)::text,'-'), ' ' ORDER BY t.strategy) AS legs, count(*) AS n, min(t.created_at) AS entered, max(t.closed_at) AS closed FROM paper_trades t WHERE t.strategy IN ('Rmmsell1','Rmmsell2') AND (t.market_ticker LIKE '%26OCT08TBDAL%' OR t.created_at >= '2026-10-09 00:00' OR (t.pnl < 0 AND t.closed_at >= '2026-10-09 02:15')) GROUP BY t.market_ticker HAVING count(*) = 1 OR bool_or(t.pnl < 0) OR t.market_ticker LIKE '%TBDAL%' ORDER BY 4
